## History

William Blair owned and operated the local store in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) where [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempted to shop for a dress. Due to his social anxiety and embarrassment, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) was intimidated by the presence of a female clerk at William's store, which forced him to abandon his errand and purchase unrelated farm supplies instead.
